messages.subject: RMarkdown Not Found
parts:
Hey all,

Running CentOS 6, I am trying to have shiny-server serve up an rmarkdown report.  However, without any logging, all I get is Not Found (just Not Found in h1, not even the pretty shiny server version).  The report builds locally and the permissions on its folder seem open.  Any ideas of what could misconfigured or be wrong?

Thanks in advance,
Mark

messages.author: 98eef9df348d3f6c
messages.subject: Re: RMarkdown Not Found
parts:
One thing I just noted by experimentation is that symlinking the Rmd file was causing the issue.  When I actually copy the file, the routing error goes away.  Any ideas, Shiny Group?

Thanks,
Mark
